authority.arithmetic: exact Python fractions and exact IEEE bit decoding

scope.distinction: These are floating source-reduction transition bands, not the 2,584 canonical exact-real cell boundaries in the separate approximation ledger.
scope.inside_bands: For B_k, both n=RNEint(z) and m=RNEint(zhat) belong to {k,k+1}.
scope.stable_interiors: Because accepted_eta < 1/4, bands about consecutive half-integer preimages are disjoint. Outside their union, z and zhat lie in the same roundTiesToEven integer cell, hence m=n.
